title: OSI reference model, layered by operational discipline
note: Each OSI layer is split into sub-layers. A sub-layer is the smallest unit a CMDB record can be filed under, and it maps to the team/discipline that owns it in practice.

layers.name: Physical
layers.summary: Electrons, photons and air. Nothing here is configurable from a shell, which is exactly why it gets skipped in outages.

sublayers.name: Copper / structured cabling
sublayers.detail: Cat5e/6/6a runs, patch panels, keystones, RJ45. 2.5GBase-T and 10GBase-T need Cat6a at full distance.

sublayers.name: Fiber & transceivers
sublayers.detail: SFP/SFP+ modules, OM3/OM4 multimode, single-mode LR, DAC cables. Transceiver mismatch is a classic silent failure.

sublayers.name: Wireless RF
sublayers.detail: Channels, EIRP, DFS, MIMO chains. Signal quality is a physics problem before it is a config problem.

sublayers.name: Power & thermal
sublayers.detail: PSU headroom, UPS runtime, PDU circuits, GPU power draw. A 4070 Ti under load changes the thermal budget of the whole room.

layers.name: Data Link
layers.summary: Getting a frame to the next hop on the same wire, and keeping loops out while doing it.

sublayers.name: Addressing & learning
sublayers.detail: MAC addresses, bridge tables, ARP/NDP caches, MAC ageing timers.

sublayers.name: VLAN segmentation
sublayers.detail: 802.1Q tags, access vs trunk ports, native VLAN hygiene, PVID assignment.

sublayers.name: Loop prevention
sublayers.detail: STP/RSTP/MSTP, BPDU guard, portfast edges. Broadcast storms start here.

sublayers.name: Aggregation & discovery
sublayers.detail: LACP bonds, LLDP/CDP neighbours, MTU consistency across a bond.

layers.name: Network
layers.summary: Where this box is, how it reaches that box, and which of the three overlapping address spaces you are in.

sublayers.name: Addressing & subnets
sublayers.detail: Prefix allocation, DHCP scopes, static reservations, IPv6 RA. Every host also carries a 100.64/10 overlay address.

sublayers.name: Routing & policy
sublayers.detail: Default gateways, static routes, policy routing, NAT/PAT, firewall rules and ACLs.

sublayers.name: Overlay / mesh VPN
sublayers.detail: WireGuard-based tailnet, node keys, ACL grants, DERP relays vs direct paths, exit nodes.

layers.name: Transport
layers.summary: Ports are the interface between a service and the network team. A CMDB that does not record them is a spreadsheet.

sublayers.name: TCP
sublayers.detail: Connection state, window scaling, congestion control, TIME_WAIT exhaustion, keepalives.

sublayers.name: UDP & QUIC
sublayers.detail: Connectionless datagrams, QUIC streams over UDP/443, MTU and PMTUD sensitivity.

sublayers.name: Port registry
sublayers.detail: Who listens on what, on which interface, loopback vs tailnet vs LAN. The most useful table in any CMDB.

sublayers.name: Proxying & LB
sublayers.detail: Reverse proxies, port forwarders, TLS termination, health checks, upstream pools.

layers.name: Session
layers.summary: Long-lived relationships: who is logged in, over what, and what happens when it drops.

sublayers.name: Shell & remote sessions
sublayers.detail: SSH sessions, keys and source restrictions, RDP, serial consoles.

sublayers.name: File sessions
sublayers.detail: SMB/NFS mounts, credentials caching, reconnect behaviour, oplocks.

sublayers.name: Auth state
sublayers.detail: Bearer tokens, API keys, OAuth device flows, cookie sessions, token expiry and re-auth.

sublayers.name: Agent & worker state
sublayers.detail: Run-state machines, leases and heads, heartbeat intervals, drift detection.

layers.name: Presentation
layers.summary: How bytes become meaning: charset, compression, serialization, and the TLS that wraps it.

sublayers.name: TLS & certificates
sublayers.detail: Certificate chains, SNI, ALPN, cipher policy, expiry tracking. Tailnet HTTPS uses short-lived certs.

sublayers.name: Serialization
sublayers.detail: JSON, NDJSON for logs, protobuf/gRPC, safetensors headers, GGUF metadata blocks.

sublayers.name: Compression & encoding
sublayers.detail: gzip/zstd, base64 for binary-in-JSON, UTF-8 assumptions, line-ending hazards.

sublayers.name: Model weight formats
sublayers.detail: fp16 safetensors, GPTQ/AWQ 4-bit, GGUF quant levels (Q4_K_M etc.) — a presentation-layer choice with physical consequences.

layers.name: Application
layers.summary: The only layer users notice. Everything below exists to make this layer's failures debuggable.

sublayers.name: HTTP APIs
sublayers.detail: REST endpoints, SSE streams, OpenAPI surfaces, auth middleware, rate limits.

sublayers.name: Inference services
sublayers.detail: Ollama and vLLM endpoints, model residency, VRAM budget, context length, token throughput.

sublayers.name: Observability
sublayers.detail: Logs to ELK, metrics to Prometheus, dashboards in Grafana, alert routing.

sublayers.name: Agent & automation
sublayers.detail: Hermes workers, cron jobs, run-state transitions, chat bots — things that act without a human.
